question: 一共有多少个订单？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: 每种订单状态各有多少单？
goldSql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question: 哪个州的卖家数量最多？
goldSql: SELECT seller_state FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 单件商品的运费最高是多少？
goldSql: SELECT MAX(freight_value) FROM order_items

question: 2017 年 11 月一共有多少个订单？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'

question: 最常用的支付方式是什么？
goldSql: SELECT payment_type FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 订单评价的平均分是多少？
goldSql: SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM order_reviews

question: 卖出商品件数最多的前 5 个商品类别是哪些？用英文类别名回答。
goldSql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: RJ 州的客户一共支付了多少钱？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(pay.payment_value) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_payments pay ON o.order_id = pay.order_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'

question: SP 州有多少个客户？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP'

question: 复购客户有多少个？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2) t

question: 2018 年的 GMV 是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

question: 一共有多少个卖家？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers

question: 有多少个商品没有填写商品类别？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

question: 5 分的评价有多少条？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5

question: 2018 年每个月分别有多少个订单？返回月份数字（1-12）和订单数。
goldSql: SELECT MONTH(order_purchase_timestamp), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(order_purchase_timestamp)

question: 用信用卡支付时，平均分几期？
goldSql: SELECT AVG(payment_installments) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

question: 哪一天的下单量最多？返回日期。
goldSql: SELECT DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM orders GROUP BY DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每种支付方式的支付总金额分别是多少？
goldSql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type

question: 已取消的订单占全部订单的比例是多少？返回 0 到 1 之间的小数。
goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: SP 州的卖家一共卖出了多少件商品？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP'

question: health_beauty 类别的商品平均售价是多少？
goldSql: SELECT AVG(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'

question: 收到 1 分评价、并且状态是已送达的订单有多少个？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 AND o.order_status = 'delivered'

question: 按客户所在城市统计，哪个城市的订单最多？
goldSql: SELECT c.customer_city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 用代金券支付过的订单，平均评分是多少？
goldSql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) FROM order_reviews r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher')

question: 平均客单价是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_payments

question: 已送达订单的平均配送天数是多少？
goldSql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_purchase_timestamp)) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: 延迟送达的订单有多少个？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question: 差评率是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews

question: 2017 年的活跃卖家有多少个？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
